text:
elaine: Heads-up: big enterprise asked for a formal retention matrix + demo for data retention across hosted/dedicated/private modes. They want per-tenant retention controls, legal-hold, and retention-by-region examples. Thoughts?

tom: For Dedicated and Private we can point to tenant config options, retention TTLs, and policy endpoints. Hosted has stricter default retention. We should include sample API calls for retention toggles.

arjun: Also note backupsand snapshots live in infra's backup bucket—must show encryption at rest and retention labels. For private, customers may manage their own snapshot lifecycle.

kelly: Legal wants the retention policy to map to SOC2 CC6 and ISO 27001 A.8.2.2. They need examples of evidence exports and legal-hold override procedures.

elaine: Can we assemble: 1) CSV mapping controls -> retention feature -> artifact; 2) demo script with curl examples; 3) quick-runbook for legal-hold extraction.

legal-bot: Reminder: include data subject request response SLA (30 days) in the runbook.

tom: I'll produce the curl examples and API snippets. arjun will supply infrastructure artifacts (encryption/backup notes). kelly will map control ids.

arjun: ETA EOW for infra artifacts.

elaine: Great. I'll coordinate a demo with the customer next Wed. Need a DO NOT DELETE note for retention toggles in the demo tenant.

kelly: Also include a note on retention exceptions and approval flow.

elaine: Thanks team — sending follow-up with a shared drive link by EOD.
